status.pendingHint: Not published yet: the zone goes live once the domain ownership is verified.
status.disabledHint: DNS hosted elsewhere: the records are created at your DNS provider.

origin.manualHint: Created by hand: never touched by the panel.
origin.autoHint: Generated from the domains and the settings, rewritten at each change. Editing it turns it into a manual record.
origin.templateHint: Copied from a DNS template, then managed like a manual record.
origin.systemHint: Short-lived challenge (certificate, ownership): managed by the panel, read-only.

createDomain.auto: Automatic (hosted here when the DNS service is on)
createDomain.external: Hosted elsewhere (records to create at my provider)
createDomain.hint: The zone gets the web records (A / AAAA, www) automatically; it is published once the ownership is verified.
createDomain.subdomainHint: A subdomain goes into the zone of its parent domain when the account has it.

wildcard.label: Wildcard (*.domain)
wildcard.hint: Also serve every subdomain (certificate through DNS-01).
wildcard.needsHosted: Needs a DNS zone hosted here (certificate through DNS-01).

zones.searchPlaceholder: Search a zone or an account…
zones.empty: No DNS zone yet: zones are created with the domains.
zones.fromDomain: For a domain of the account
zones.noDomainWithoutZone: Every domain of this account already has a zone.
zones.name: Zone name
zones.hostedHint: Served by our name servers once the domain ownership is verified.
zones.externalHint: Not published here: the panel lists the records to create at your DNS provider.

zone.title: DNS zone
zone.label: DNS zone
zone.notFound: This zone does not exist or is not visible to you.
zone.deleteConfirm: Delete the zone {{name}} and all its records? Our name servers stop answering for it.
zone.kindChangeTitle: Change where the DNS is hosted
zone.toExternalConfirm: The zone stops being served by our name servers. Create the listed records at your DNS provider and update the delegation at your registrar first. Continue?
zone.toHostedConfirm: The zone will be served by our name servers once the domain is verified. Then set our name servers at your registrar. Continue?
zone.applyTtlToRecords: Also apply it to every existing record

records.title: Records
records.externalNotice: This zone is hosted elsewhere: these records are not published by our name servers.
records.autoEditNotice: This record is generated by the panel. Once edited it becomes a manual record: the panel no longer updates it (for instance when the server IP changes).
records.txtHint: Without quotes; long texts are split into 255-character strings automatically.
records.disabledHint: Kept in the panel but not published.
records.disableAutoConfirm: Automatic records follow the domain and cannot be deleted. Disable {{type}} {{name}} → {{content}}? It becomes a manual record that stays disabled (a zone reset restores it).

name.outOfZone: The name must stay inside the zone.
name.label: Invalid name: letters, digits, - and _ only, labels of at most 63 characters.
name.wildcard: A * is only allowed as the first label.

validation.hostname: Not a valid host name (e.g. mail.example.com).
validation.txtChars: The text cannot contain control characters (line breaks).
validation.caaValue: A value is required (no double quote), e.g. letsencrypt.org.
validation.cnameApex: A CNAME cannot be placed at the zone apex.
validation.nsApex: The apex NS records are managed by the panel: an NS record only delegates a sub-zone.
validation.cnameExclusive: A CNAME cannot coexist with another record of the same name.

dnssec.hint: Signs the zone (ECDSA P-256). Publish the DS record below at your registrar to activate the chain of trust.
dnssec.ds: DS records to publish at the registrar
dnssec.enabled: DNSSEC enabled: publish the DS record at your registrar
dnssec.disableConfirm: Remove the DS records at your registrar FIRST and wait for their TTL to expire: otherwise the domain stops resolving for validating resolvers. Disable DNSSEC now?

expected.title: Records to create at your DNS provider
expected.help: The DNS of this domain is hosted elsewhere: create these records at your provider. Nothing is published by our name servers.
expected.nsTitle: Name servers to set at the registrar
expected.nsHelp: Declare these name servers at the registrar of the domain so that this zone is served.

delegation.title: Delegation
delegation.help: Asks the public resolvers which name servers the domain points to, and compares them with ours.
delegation.ok: The domain is delegated to our name servers.
delegation.notOk: The domain is not (yet) delegated to our name servers.

reset.title: Reset the zone
reset.text: The automatic records are regenerated from the domains and the settings.
reset.dropWarning: Every manual record is deleted as well.
reset.templateWarning: Records that came from a template are deleted, then recreated only from the template linked to the zone (if any). Template records you edited are manual and follow the option below.

templates.hint: Records added to new zones of the workspace (the default template) or applied to a zone on demand.
templates.name: Name
templates.isDefaultHint: Applied to every new zone of the workspace (one default at most).
templates.placeholders: Placeholders, replaced when the template is applied:
templates.deleteConfirm: Delete the template « {{name}} »? Existing zones keep their records.
templates.applyHint: The records of the template are added to the zone (placeholders replaced); conflicting records are reported.

errors.zoneExists: A zone with this name already exists.
errors.zoneHasDomain: The zone still belongs to a domain: delete the domain (or change its DNS mode) first.
errors.recordConflict: Conflicting record: a CNAME cannot coexist with another record of the same name, nor sit at the apex; an NS at the apex is managed by the panel.
errors.recordLimit: The zone reached its limit of 500 records.
errors.systemRecord: This record is managed by the panel and cannot be modified.
errors.zoneNotHosted: The zone is hosted elsewhere: switch it to « hosted here » first.
errors.dnsDisabled: The DNS service is disabled on this platform.
errors.templateInvalid: The template is invalid: check its records.
errors.backendUnavailable: The DNS server cannot be reached right now. Retry in a moment.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests: wait a moment, then retry.
errors.notImplemented: This DNS feature is not available on this server yet.
errors.recordAutoOrigin: Automatic records follow the domain and cannot be deleted: disable or edit the record instead (it then becomes a manual override).

domainOwnership.title: Ownership

badge.pendingHint: Ownership not proven yet: visitors see a placeholder page and no certificate is issued.

domainOwnership.createHint: After creation, prove that you own the domain (TXT record or our name servers): until then visitors see a placeholder page and no certificate is issued.
domainOwnership.pendingText: Until the ownership is proven, visitors see a placeholder page and no certificate is issued. The site stays reachable through its preview URL.
domainOwnership.txtHelp: At the DNS provider of the domain, create this TXT record, then click « Check now ». Propagation can take a few minutes.
domainOwnership.nsHelp: Or delegate the domain to our name servers at your registrar: the zone is then served by this panel. Every public NS of the domain must be one of these.
domainOwnership.verifiedInherited: Verified through the parent domain {{parent}} of the same account.
domainOwnership.forceConfirm: Mark {{name}} as verified without a DNS proof? Only do this when you know the account owns the domain. The action is audited.

claims.title: Domain claims
claims.help: Create this TXT record at the DNS provider of the domain, then check the claim (before {{date}}). On success the domain moves to your account, verified; its current holder is notified.
claims.whereToCheck: The claim is listed above the domains: check it from there once the record is published.
claims.takenText: If the domain is yours, claim it: you prove the ownership with a TXT record, then the domain is moved to this account.

errors.txtMissing: The TXT record was not found by the public resolvers.
errors.txtMismatch: A TXT record exists but its value does not match.
errors.nsMismatch: The public name servers are not ours.
errors.resolverFailed: The public resolvers could not be queried. Retry in a moment.
errors.domainNotVerified: The domain ownership is not verified yet: verify it first.
errors.claimNotNeeded: No claim needed: the name is free or already belongs to this account.
errors.claimExpired: The claim expired: start a new one.
errors.wildcardNeedsHostedZone: A wildcard needs an active DNS zone hosted here (certificate through DNS-01).
errors.notImplemented: Domain verification is not available on this server yet.
